verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs explicitly describe shared workspace collaboration—inviting designers, developers, or agencies with real-time visibility into changes—but note that concurrent editors work in separate drafts rather than a single live shared session, which limits true simultaneous co-editing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of multi-user real-time collaboration in practice, details on permissions/roles within a shared workspace, and confirmation that draft merging works smoothly at scale.
